   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
   // Sub Domain 정보 가져오기
    var subGR = new GlideRecord('u_sub_domain');
    if (subGR.get(producer.sub_domain)) {

        var top = producer.top_category;
        var subCode = subGR.code;

        // Inquiry Code 생성
        current.u_inquiry_code = top + "-" + subCode;
    }

    // 값 저장

    current.u_sub_domain = producer.sub_domain;
    current.description = producer.description;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-03-13 02:15:20</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f966ce5a472bba10456e8c64116d4326</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Save Inquiry Code</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Safety Desk" source="x_1903597_safety_0">d60dec6f53d3f210eea679a0a0490e26</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Safety Desk">d60dec6f53d3f210eea679a0a0490e26</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_f966ce5a472bba10456e8c64116d4326</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-13 02:15:20</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
